title: Pipes - Insulated Heat Loss Diagrams
description: Heat loss (W/ft) diagrams for 1/2 to 6 inches insulated pipes - ranging insulation thickness 0.5 to 4 inches and temperature differences 50 to 350 degF. Based on metal pipes with fiber glass insulation (thermal conductivity 0.25 Btu/h oF ft2/in) and moderate wind conditions (20 mph) with 10% safety factor.

components.content:
## Adjustment Factors

- **Indoor location**: Reduce values by 10%
- **Mineral wool insulation**: Increase values by 6%
- **Rigid cellular polyurethane**: Reduce values by 30%

## Unit Conversions

- 1 W/ft = 3.41 Btu/h ft = 3.28 W/m
- 1 oF = 0.555 oC

## Assumptions

- Material: Metal pipes with fiber glass insulation
- Thermal conductivity: 0.25 Btu/h oF ft²/in
- Outdoor conditions: Moderate wind (20 mph)
- Safety factor: 10% included
